result.instructions: Tools for AssetTiger, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which assets are checked out to Maria Jansen right now?"; "List the assets in the Berlin site that are in the repair category."; "Check out asset 1042 to person 17 and send no email.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes AssetTiger data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run assettiger_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run assettiger_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run assettiger_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. assettiger_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: assettiger_list_assets
tools.title: List assets
tools.description: List assets with optional filters by category, site, location, department, person or customer, plus search and paging. Good first call to find a refId. GET /v1/assets.

personRefId.description: Filter by the person the asset is checked out to.

customerRefId.description: Filter by the customer the asset is checked out to.

orderBy.description: Field to sort by, named as the API names it.

fetchEvent.description: Include each asset's current event in the reply.

fetchCustomFields.description: Include custom field values in the reply.

tools.name: assettiger_get_asset
tools.title: Get an asset
tools.description: Get one asset by refId, with its details and, if asked, its current event and custom fields. GET /v1/assets/{refId}.

refId.description: The record's refId (the numeric id returned by a list call).

fetchEvent.description: Include the current event in the reply.

fetchCustomFields.description: Include custom field values in the reply.

refId.description: The record's refId (the numeric id returned by a list call).

orderBy.description: Field to sort by, named as the API names it.

refId.description: The record's refId (the numeric id returned by a list call).

tools.name: assettiger_create_asset
tools.title: Create an asset
tools.description: Create one asset in the organisation's AssetTiger account. assetTagId and description are required. Creates a new record each call, so do not retry blindly. POST /v1/assets/add.

assetTagId.description: The asset tag (unique label on the item).

assetLife.description: Useful life, in the unit the account uses.

tools.name: assettiger_check_out_asset
tools.title: Check out an asset
tools.description: Check an asset out to a person, a customer or a site/location. Sends no email unless sendEmail is true. POST /v1/assets/{refId}/events/checkout/add.

refId.description: The record's refId (the numeric id returned by a list call).

checkoutTo.description: Who or what receives the asset.

date1.description: Check-out date and time, for example 2026-03-01T09:30:00.

sendEmail.description: Send the notification email. Default false.

overrideReservation.description: Check out even if a reservation exists. Default false.

tools.name: assettiger_check_in_asset
tools.title: Check in an asset
tools.description: Return a checked-out asset and optionally move it to a new site, location or department. Sends no email unless sendEmail is true. POST /v1/assets/{refId}/events/checkin/add.

refId.description: The record's refId (the numeric id returned by a list call).

date1.description: Local date and time, for example 2026-03-01T09:30:00.

newSiteRefId.description: Move the asset to this site on check-in.

newLocationRefId.description: Move the asset to this location on check-in.

sendEmail.description: Send the notification email. Default false.
